Lemma
[Abstract cone curvature block] ↗ def:curvature-operator

Let $A$ be a bounded endomorphism of a normed real vector space $V$ and define $B_s$ on $V\oplus W$ by \[ B_s(x,y)=(s^2Ax,0). \] If $Ax=\lambda x$, then $B_s(x,0)=s^2\lambda (x,0)$, while $B_s(0,y)=0$ for every $y\in W$.
